body: seat_clone_root now applies the aida-seat-* name / marker test to the nearest ancestor with ANY .git entry, and never consults the entry's type. verified_main additionally requires a real .git directory, so a rewired clone is Unverified and refused. New tests cover a symlinked .git and a gitdir: file, each with a core.fsmonitor and a filter.clean canary. worktree_dirty_entries and host_git_command (status, add -A, diff) refuse, and neither canary fires. A live-canary control shows the planted filter does fire under plain git. Both tests fail with the old check order. origin/main is merged; normal push. 20 seat_clone tests pass; check-ci-fast and check-ci-compile pass.
